title: Will cut your fingers and hard to open. Don’t last in dishwasher.
text:
Will cut your fingers and hard to open. Don’t last in dishwasher.. These are not as reusable as I was hoping. Dishwasher seems to take more of a toll than expected.

However, three stars due to them being very hard to open AND very sharp.

One star because I cut my finger tip trying to open one last week and they crack and break after 1 or 2 dishwasher cycles.

They also stain badly. The tops even worse. I made chocolate ice cream and those lids are literally brown coming out of the dishwasher.

I won’t reorder these before trying a different manufacturer.
